comps.label: C1
comps.reason: Holds boutique active managers earning AUM fees from institutions and intermediaries; economics closely resemble Artisan's, though structured as a holding company.

comps.label: C2
comps.reason: Public active manager with mutual funds, separate accounts, institutional and intermediary distribution, and AUM-based fees; narrower real-assets focus.

comps.label: C3
comps.reason: Active equity and fixed income manager selling mutual funds and separate accounts to institutions and intermediaries for AUM fees.

comps.label: C4
comps.reason: Alternatives fund-of-funds and private markets manager with carried interest; differs from active public equity and fixed income.

comps.label: C5
comps.reason: Primarily research, data, ratings and software subscriptions; asset management is a minor part of the business.

comps.label: C6
comps.reason: Private markets fund-of-funds, venture and private credit on committed capital; differs from active public-market strategies.

comps.label: C7
comps.reason: Mainly wealth technology platforms and operations outsourcing sold to banks; investment management is secondary.

comps.label: C8
comps.reason: Wealth manager serving high-net-worth families through direct advisors with planning services, unlike Artisan's institutional and intermediary fund distribution.

comps.label: C9
comps.reason: Multi-boutique active manager selling mutual funds and separate accounts via intermediaries and institutions for AUM fees.

comps.label: C10
comps.reason: ETF and crypto product sponsor with passive, rules-based products and tokenization; differs from active multi-team management.
